notes.title: Update 1.42 - Additional hints!
notes.content:
[h1]Added visual hints for items
[/h1]
To make it easier to find well-hidden items, visual effects have been added that are displayed every few seconds and can be seen exactly where the item is located. To maintain balance and equilibrium, these effects are not very visible, but at the same time manage to draw the player's eye.

notes.title: Update 1.4 "Hints Update"
notes.content:
[h1]News[/h1]
[h2]- New hint mechanics have been added. From now on, players in difficult situations, can use a hint to help them complete a puzzle. To do so, just click on the magnifying glass icon located in the lower right corner of the screen while solving puzzles.[/h2]

[h2]- New music has been added when talking to an employee[/h2]

[h2]- Changed the graphics of the Wilson Square subway. Rest assured, the spilled coffee remains :)[/h2]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] - Fixed spelling errors (both Polish and English)
[*] - added interaction caption to one of the items
[*] - changed the position of the interaction button field to one of the characters (previously it was not in the same place where the character stood)
[*] - fixed a bug in which the text “number does not exist” kept appearing when making a call
[*] - fixed several icon graphics and character graphics
[*] - fixed problems with the inscription remaining next to the cursor (which should not be there at the moment)
[*] - decreased or increased several object graphics
[*] - added sounds signaling the correct completion of one puzzle
[*] - several lines of dialog have been changed
[*] - fixed a bug where you could enter the subway during dialogue
[*] - a few other minor things have been added/fixed
[/list]
